public_site_rebuild: RESEARCH_PREVIEW; scholar and official publication gates remain open
count_note: Certification count means no record has passed the new strict scholarly release gate, not that all underlying information is false. Live bibliography/import counts are computed in data/research_audit_v0.7.json when built.

generated_review_outputs.note: Paths are build targets; successful build and browser tests must be checked separately.

reconciliation_note: On 2026-09-19 CURRENT pointed to the older v0.4 deep_fields structure while the preserved v0.6 authority_routes/versions/typed_relations records were available. The baseline pointer is explicitly restored to v0.6; v0.7 adds transparent review overlays, not a silent overwrite.
rules: Official scholarly publication remains gated; a functional research preview may be built with visible limitations.
Website inputs must be canonical datasets plus the explicit named review overlays.
Historical snapshots must not silently replace a newer canonical baseline.
A direct authority route does not prove identical recensions or available translation text.
Work, Version, Witness and Parallel are distinct entities.
Collection-level context is not proof of a specific item holding.
Public image assets use PNG/JPG; legacy SVGs are not final public visual assets.
No public website deployment is implied by successful compilation or by a GitHub file link.

site.style: ivory, lavender and warm gold; accessible story-first atlas
site.data_mode: embedded canonical data and explicit evidence review overlays
